incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT alert - Sev2 - GPU OOM spike in us-west1 prefill path. Multiple container restarts observed across gke-gpu-pool-2 starting ~03:24Z. Paging oncall: @sara_eng_oncall
sara_eng_oncall: On it. Pulling logs and checking node health. Can someone paste the most recent stacktrace?
matt_sre: Seeing repeated CUDA OOM then process exit 137 on pods prefill-processor-*. Node gke-gpu-node-12 showing sustained GPU memory pressure (98%). KVCACHE growth correlated with long requests.
lina_ml: Traffic analysis shows several very large-context requests (many ~100k+ token prefill). We should throttle prefill path and enforce a max token cap ASAP.
sara_eng_oncall: Rolling quick mitigation: set `PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=32768` on prefill deployment and enable `PREFILL_STREAM_TRIM=true`. Matt — can you cordon the noisy nodes and drain safely?
matt_sre: Cordon + drain started for gke-gpu-node-12. Commands run: `kubectl cordon gke-gpu-node-12 && kubectl drain gke-gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — moving pods to healthier nodes.
alex_support: Two customers reported degraded responses. Preparing a short status note. Need ETA and a 1-line root cause for comms.
jordan_prod: For customer note: "We observed GPU memory exhaustion caused by unusually large prefill requests; mitigation is in progress and we will post updates."
sara_eng_oncall: Requesting hotpool scale +2 and temporary gateway rule to reject >32k token prefill requests. deploy-bot can you bump hotpool replicas?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scaling prefill-hotpool from 8 -> 10 replicas. Change applied.
lina_ml: Long-term recommendations: enforce token caps at the gateway, add prefix/KV eviction during prefill, and per-tenant prefill rate-limits. I'll file follow-up tickets and a mitigation runbook.
matt_sre: Drain completed for node-12, pods rescheduled. Found a CUDA stacktrace in logs that looks like an integer overflow when computing allocation size: ```E Cuda: failed to allocate 35184372088832 bytes; out of memory``` — allocation size clearly corrupted on large-context branch.
sara_eng_oncall: Investigating tokenizer/prefill math paths for overflow. If true, hotfix to sanitize token counts before allocation.
alex_support: Drafted customer update: "Mitigation: throttles applied, suspicious long-context requests blocked, capacity increased. Next update in 30m." Approve?
jordan_prod: Approve. Add note that Dedicated customers may see automatic fallback to smaller model variants to preserve availability.
matt_sre: Monitoring metrics: error rate down ~80%, restarts dropped to 0 in the last 6m. Keeping an eye on KVCACHE size and node memory metrics.
sara_eng_oncall: If metrics remain stable we'll demote to Sev3 in 30m and keep channel open for 1h for regression watch.
incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Incident owner: sara_eng_oncall. Please attach post-incident report link when available.
